heroShowcase.philosophy1: Developing skill through doing, guiltlessly exploring passion for technology, imbuing quality. Mindful that every system is someone's vision realized.

about.subtitle: Full-Stack Developer
about.block1P1: From translation to web development – my journey began with a fascination for languages, both human and digital. I am passionate about developing and transforming ideas into digital experiences.
about.block1P2: What drives me? The ability to translate needs and visions into digital applications, simplify processes and ensure efficient workflows.
about.block2P1: My focus is on the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), which enables me to build seamless full-stack applications. Over the past two years, I've been working intensively with React and Next.js.
about.block2P2: I'm particularly passionate about developing SaaS solutions: products that solve real problems, scale effectively, and support people in their work.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Sub1Text: The following information provides an overview of how your personal data is processed when you visit this website. Personal data is any data with which you can be personally identified.

privacy.section1Sub2Text: Data processing on this website is carried out by the website operator. You can find their contact details in the section "Notice about the responsible party".
privacy.section1Sub3Title: How do I collect your data?
privacy.section1Sub3Text: Your data is collected when you provide it to me – for example, via the contact form. Other data is collected automatically or with your consent by my IT systems when you visit the website. This mainly includes technical data (e.g., internet browser, operating system, or time of page access).
privacy.section1Sub4Title: What do I use your data for?
privacy.section1Sub4Text: Part of the data is collected to ensure error-free provision of the website. Other data may be used to analyze your user behavior.
privacy.section1Sub5Title: What rights do you have regarding your data?
privacy.section1Sub5Text: You have the right to obtain free information about the origin, recipients, and purpose of your stored personal data at any time. You also have the right to request correction or deletion of this data. Under certain circumstances, you may also request restriction of processing. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

I take the protection of your personal data very seriously. I treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the statutory data protection regulations and this privacy policy.

Please note that data transmission over the Internet (e.g., when communicating by email) may have security vulnerabilities. Complete protection of data from third-party access is not possible.

Processing is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR (contract initiation) or Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest). Data is not passed on without your consent.
